confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Brazilian Northeast price levels; no live menus, booking pages, or current listings were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary more by season and location. Cocktail and wine anchors are estimated relative to beer because direct knowledge is weak. FX: the 0.6955 observation for 2026-10-15 came from search-result text attributed to the RBA; I did not open the RBA F11 table to confirm it. A 2026-10-16 figure from a third-party site was not used because it is unverified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Brazilian Northeast coastal cities with similar tourism and price levels, adjusted for Recife's generally lower prices than Rio or São Paulo. Estimates are reasoned in BRL terms and converted to USD at approximately 5.5 BRL per USD, with the July 2026 window in mind.
